_comment: One question per threshold: which split produced this number? The harness refuses to
emit a valid run when the answer is 'report' — a threshold selected on the report split
has been fitted to the numbers it is then used to report, and nothing in the resulting
file can tell a reader that.
tune     — chosen on the dataset's tune split. The normal, correct answer.
report   — chosen on the report split. INVALIDATES THE RUN. Must be empty in practice.
policy   — fixed by policy, not fitted to data (e.g. Vmax). Never a tuning claim.
ops-default — an operational default agreed by the leads, not fitted to data.
untuned  — still at the registry default. FUSION.md §5 records the shipped values as
'TBD by tuning', so this is the honest current state. A metric resting on an
untuned threshold is a pipeline reading, not a tuned operating point, and the
harness marks it provisional in summary.md.
A threshold with NO entry here is treated as unrecorded and also blocks the run. 'We do
not know which split chose it' is not a licence to publish it.
When a threshold IS tuned: change selectedOnSplit to 'tune', put the run-id that did the
tuning in runId, the UTC date in selectedAtUtc, and your name in owner. That is the whole
workflow, and it is deliberately small — a provenance rule that is tedious gets skipped.

entries.name: T_FACE_RED
entries.note: Shipped default 0.35 is FUSION.md §5's 'TBD by tuning' placeholder, not a fitted value. NOTE: ThresholdName.T_FACE_RED.tuningDataRef reads 'D-FACE report split' — see the spec-conflict section of summary.md.

entries.name: T_FACE_GREEN
entries.note: Shipped default 0.55. Same conflict as T_FACE_RED.

entries.name: T_ALIAS_HI
entries.note: R-ALIAS-01 needs supervisor confirmation on top of the similarity threshold; the threshold alone is not the rule.

entries.name: T_WL
entries.note: A-WL-01 fires at any similarity at or above this value.

entries.name: DELTA_MARGIN
entries.note: Runner-up gap: no solo action within delta.

entries.name: MACRO_MARGIN_RED
entries.note: Below this the patch is not trusted and fusion abstains (A-WORN-01). Requires the classifier to exist first.

entries.name: MACRO_MARGIN_AMBER
entries.note: At least one zone at or above this counts as confident enough to disagree (R-PROC-02).

entries.name: Q_BLUR
entries.note: Laplacian variance floor; tuned on novice field runs for a field-like GREY rate under 8%.

entries.name: Q_GLARE
entries.note: Glare ratio ceiling.

entries.name: Q_BRIGHT_MIN
entries.note: Darkness floor; fail-closed to GREY(G_DARK).

entries.name: Q_BRIGHT_MAX
entries.note: Overexposure ceiling; fail-closed to GREY(G_GLARE).

entries.name: Q_POSE_YAW
entries.note: Yaw ceiling in degrees.

entries.name: Q_POSE_PITCH
entries.note: Pitch ceiling in degrees.

entries.name: VMAX
entries.note: 120 km/h, fixed by policy (FUSION.md §2 R-TRAV-01) and logged, not fitted. This is a policy value and is never a report-split tuning claim.

entries.name: RECHECK_P
entries.note: 5% random full re-check rate. Operational default, supervisor-adjustable and logged (FUSION.md §8).

entries.name: REVERIFY_DAYS
entries.note: 30-day re-verification interval for the trust lane.

entries.name: FACILITATOR_MIN_GROUPS
entries.note: A-FAC-01: many crossings sharing at most this many distinct groups.

entries.name: FACILITATOR_WINDOW_DAYS
entries.note: A-FAC-01 window in days.

entries.name: GREY_STREAK_LIMIT
entries.note: A-GREY3: three consecutive GREYs is itself a finding, because it is the signature of someone gaming the retake loop.

entries.name: VIZ_DRIFT_TOLERANCE
entries.note: A-VIZ-01: how far the visual zone may drift from the MRZ on a non-check-digit field before it is a finding.
